name: Marjorie Gerardi
bio: Marjorie Gerardi (São Paulo, March 14, 1989) is a Brazilian actress and dancer. She began her career on stage with classical ballet.

credits.title: Two Cecilias
credits.overview: A village in São Paulo becomes the center of a conflict over property speculation while a series of mysterious disappearances uncovers secrets hidden beneath the city's transformation.

credits.title: 8 Segundos: O Desafio
credits.overview: Helena is the daughter of rancher Sinval and the sister of João Donato, a renowned international rodeo champion. Her dream is to become a top female rodeo rider, despite her father’s objections, so she divides her time between secret riding practice and her work as a doctor in Barretos.

credits.title: MMA - A Fathers Fight
credits.overview: When Max, a former MMA world champion about to retire, discovers he has an 8-year-old autistic son, his life is turned upside down. Now, as he trains for one last opportunity to regain his world champion title, Max must deal with his new family and his father, from whom he has long been estranged.

credits.title: Silvio
credits.overview: Just 12 hours after having his daughter in the custody of a kidnapper, the influential communicator Sílvio Santos faces an even more complicated obstacle: his home is invaded and he is held hostage for seven hours. credits.title: Someone Borrowed
credits.overview: To fulfill his mother’s dying wish and avoid being removed from her will, an inflexible bachelor hires an actress to play his fiancée.

credits.title: O Homem Perfeito
credits.overview: Diana is a successful and happily married woman. At least that's what she thinks until she finds out that her husband is cheating on her with a young aspiring dancer.

credits.title: Amazon Obhijaan
credits.overview: Anna, an Italian woman, approaches Shankar, an explorer, to accompany her in search of the golden city of El Dorado. He accepts the offer and sets out on an adventure through the Amazon.

credits.title: Gostosas, Lindas e Sexies
credits.overview: In Rio de Janeiro there live four great and inseparable friends: Beatriz, Tânia, Ivone and Marilu. They wear a plus size mannequin and face all the adventures and love and professional mismatches that four young women can face in the capital of Rio de Janeiro, (almost) always in a good mood.

credits.title: Stronger Than The World
credits.overview: The Story of longtime UFC Featherweight champion and the struggles facing him on the road to the top.
